package.description: Move active window or app between virtual desktops using hotkeys

en-US.description: Move active window or app between virtual desktops using hotkeys
en-US.longDescription: Windows 10 and 11 let you switch between virtual desktops using Ctrl+Win+Arrow, but they lack a built-in shortcut to move the currently active window to another desktop. This utility fills that gap by allowing you to move your active window or app to the next or previous virtual desktop on Windows 10 / 11 with a single keyboard shortcut - a feature Microsoft should have included long ago.
en-US.name: Move Window Between Desktops
